---
name: simplify-agents-md
description: Rewrites AGENTS.md to be shorter and clearer by eliminating redundancy and merging overlapping instructions. Use when AGENTS.md has grown too long or needs a cleanup pass.
---

Rewrite `AGENTS.md` to be concise and fluent:

1. Read the current file and identify duplicate, overlapping, or overly verbose instructions.
2. Merge related instructions into single, direct statements.
3. Preserve every distinct rule and its intent — nothing should be silently dropped.
4. Retain the existing heading structure; remove a section only if it becomes empty after consolidation.
5. Overwrite `AGENTS.md` with the simplified result.
